value.rationale: This gives a natural complete all-rank classification of finite vertex-set convexification for uniform-matroid base polytopes. Two independent rank/corank boundary faces set sharp thresholds, while a pointwise sorted-coordinate criterion classifies the entire intermediate family of uncovered regions, not just a known simplex or zonotope case. This exact geometric coverage profile sharpens qualitative finiteness criteria and can be applied to rank-dependent vertex-generation questions. No broader unproved matroid generalization is suggested as established.
